strings.Ui_Settings_Item_BackgroundKind_Desc: Background behind empty window areas: solid, gradient, local image or the newest screenshot of the current instance; cards stay opaque so text remains readable. No background is drawn under system high contrast.
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_BackgroundOpacity_Desc: Overall opacity percentage of the background layer (0–100).
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_BackgroundScene_Desc: Built-in procedural line-art background shown only when no custom background is active and high contrast is off; cards stay opaque. Changes apply immediately and keep each scene's slow motion and pointer response.
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_BackgroundScope_Desc: “Current instance only” stores the whole background in BackgroundByInstance; switching back to “global” removes this instance's override.
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_CacheSizeLimit_Desc: Above the cap, cache management runs “trim to cap”; leave empty for no limit.
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_CloseToTray_Desc: The close button hides the window instead of exiting; use “Exit” in the tray menu to quit.
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_Density_Desc: Compact, standard and comfortable affect row height and padding; applied right after saving.
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_DevBuilds_Desc: When enabled, update checks include dev builds; when off, only stable releases are tracked.
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_DownloadCacheDir_Desc: Leave empty to use Core's default cache folder.
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_FontScale_Desc: Five steps from 90% to 130%, scaling only UI text and headings; data text such as mod names and versions keeps its size.
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_GlobalInstallFiltersKsp: One filter expression per line, for example not:*.zip; leave empty for no filtering.
One filter expression per line, for example not:*.zip; leave empty for no filtering.
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_Locale_Desc: Language changes take effect after restarting the app.
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_MinimizeToTray_Desc: When minimised, keep only a tray icon instead of a taskbar entry.
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_MotionIntensity_Desc: Strength of UI animations and transitions. Follows the system “reduce motion” setting by default; the reduced step keeps only a 90 ms hover and press response.
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_PreferredHosts_Desc: One host per line, top to bottom by priority; an empty line marks where the remaining hosts go.
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_RadiusScale_Desc: Three corner radius ratios; square, standard soft corners or large round corners.
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_RefreshRate_Desc: 0 means no automatic refresh; leave empty to use the default.
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_StabilityTolerance_Desc: Written to the current instance's CKAN/stability_tolerance.json and only affects that instance; “stable” installs only mods marked stable.
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_SuppressRecommendations: Skips the recommended mods dialog when installing; you can change it back in that dialog at any time.
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_Theme_Desc: The high contrast theme is forced when system high contrast is on.
strings.Ui_Settings_Language_Hint: The interface updates immediately after switching. No restart and no code change needed.
strings.Ui_Settings_Language_LegacyWarning: The legacy CKAN client does not support this language; the interface falls back to English.
strings.Ui_Settings_Notice_HighContrastLock: High contrast is on system-wide: theme, accent colour and background are controlled by the system, so changes here have no effect.
strings.Ui_Settings_Section_Advanced_Desc: Diagnostics can be pasted straight into an issue; the folder buttons open the matching location in your file manager.
strings.Ui_Settings_Section_Appearance_Desc: Theme, language and density; written to ckan-ui.json only, never to Core config.
strings.Ui_Settings_Section_AuthToken_Desc: Access tokens per host; the UI only shows a masked preview and plaintext is never logged.
strings.Ui_Settings_Section_Compatibility_Desc: Per-instance stable tolerance and the game-wide install filters.
strings.Ui_Settings_Section_DownloadCache_Desc: Where mod archives are cached and the size cap.
strings.Ui_Settings_Section_General_Desc: Behaviour that is not tied to a specific instance.
strings.Ui_Settings_Section_Instance_Desc: The instance opened automatically when this app starts.
strings.Ui_Settings_Section_Repository_Desc: How often repository metadata refreshes and the host priority.
strings.Ui_Settings_Status_HighContrastOwned: {0}: system high contrast owns the appearance
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_MasterMuted_Desc: Mute all sound effects and music with one switch.
strings.Ui_Settings_Item_SoundEffects_Desc: Play feedback sounds for clicks, checks, toggles, and pop-up prompts.

strings.Ui_FirstRun_Kicker: Five steps to a working CKAN
strings.Ui_FirstRun_Locate_Body: Scanned Steam libraries, the registry and common install paths. Pick the right folder, or choose one manually.
strings.Ui_FirstRun_Locate_Empty: No KSP found. Choose the game folder manually (it needs GameData and KSP.exe).
strings.Ui_FirstRun_Locate_NoPicker: No folder picker is available here.
strings.Ui_FirstRun_Locate_NoSelection: Pick a KSP folder first, or choose one manually.
strings.Ui_FirstRun_Locate_NotKsp: That folder does not look like a KSP root: GameData and KSP.exe must both exist.
strings.Ui_FirstRun_Metadata_Body: Fetch the official index (metadata for 2000+ mods). It is what makes search, install and dependency resolution work.
strings.Ui_FirstRun_Metadata_Missing: Not fetched (refresh on the Repositories page)
strings.Ui_FirstRun_Metadata_SkipHint: You can skip this and refresh later on the Repositories page once you are online.
strings.Ui_FirstRun_Mods_Body: The basics almost everyone runs. Nothing is pre-checked — tick what you want; you can uninstall later.
strings.Ui_FirstRun_Mods_Zero: 0 (add some on the Mods page any time)
strings.Ui_FirstRun_Proxy_Body: CKAN pulls its index and mods from GitHub. If a direct connection does not work, set a proxy — every download will use it.
strings.Ui_FirstRun_Proxy_Invalid: The proxy address should look like http://host:port.
strings.Ui_FirstRun_Version_Body: CKAN picks mods for the versions listed here. Only the real game version is checked by default; tick older ones to install mods that have not caught up yet.
strings.Ui_FirstRun_Version_LoadFailed: Could not read the compatible versions; you can skip this step.
strings.Ui_FirstRun_Welcome_Body: A mod manager for Kerbal Space Program. The next few steps do four things: find the game, sort out downloads, align the game version, and fetch a mod index. Every step can be skipped, and you can start over from Settings → First-run setup.
strings.Ui_FirstRun_Welcome_Note: This wizard installs nothing on its own and collects no data.
strings.Ui_Onboarding_Step1_Desc: The next-generation modern mod manager built for Kerbal Space Program. Enjoy automated dependency resolution, conflict detection, and one-click installs. Let's take a quick tour of the key features!
strings.Ui_Onboarding_Step2_Desc: Easily switch between core modules in the sidebar: Manage Mods, Game Instances, Play Time, Saves, Residual Cleanup, Cache, and Settings. Click the top-left toggle to expand or collapse the sidebar.
strings.Ui_Onboarding_Step3_Desc: The top bar provides Forward/Back page history. Press Ctrl+K anytime to summon the Command Palette for instant search across all features. Press F1 to reopen this guide anytime.
strings.Ui_Onboarding_Step4_Desc: Under multifaceted modules like Manage Mods, use top tabs to seamlessly glide between Content, Changeset, Repositories, and Mod Config.
strings.Ui_Onboarding_Step5_Desc: The bottom bar displays real-time readiness and instance info. The compact pill widget monitors background downloads and installs—click to view the full queue and logs.
strings.Ui_Onboarding_Step6_Desc: You now know the basics! Pick your favorite mods and begin building your ultimate Kerbal space program. Safe travels!
